channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for South Florida Families
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District on Saturday released investigative reports detailing allegations of hazing and workplace misconduct that led to the termination of three firefighters and the suspension of two others. item.title: Waterspout crosses Indian River Lagoon in Sebastian, lightning strikes cause fires in Port St. Lucie
item.description: Friday's severe weather brought a large waterspout over the Indian River Lagoon in Sebastian and lightning strikes that ignited fires in Port St. Lucie.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK flights in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Health officials confirm E. coli and cyclospora cases in St. Lucie and Martin counties
item.description: Two St. Lucie County residents and one Martin County resident have confirmed cyclospora infections since May, part of a national outbreak linked to contaminated lettuce.

item.title: Major League Baseball restricts dugout iPad use to block AI decision-making
item.description: MLB made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday to prevent teams from using artificial intelligence for substitutions and pitch calling.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement and private companies are executing a two-year security plan for Sunday's Argentina-Spain final, with President Trump attending the trophy presentation.

item.title: Photographer's 2007 image of Messi bathing infant Yamal goes viral before World Cup final
item.description: Barcelona photographer Joan Monfort took photos of teenage Lionel Messi bathing baby Lamine Yamal in 2007 for a charity calendar. Now the two face off Sunday in the World Cup final.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks 27-year-old mile world record in London
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 at Saturday's Diamond League event, shattering Hicham El Guerrouj's 1999 mark of 3:43.13.

item.title: Fort Pierce Unity in the Community event connects families with services
item.description: The annual Unity in the Community event in Fort Pierce brought together families with public safety demonstrations and community resources.

item.title: Lightning strike ignites brush fire near Castinet Lane in Port St. Lucie
item.description: A lightning strike ignited vegetation near the 1900 block of Castinet Lane in Port St. Lucie during Friday's severe weather.
